characters.notes: Woman who becomes anxious after seeing a text about 'Pasaklı Gülsüm' and seeks help from Hoca Nefise Hanım.
Neighborhood woman known as a hoca/püfçü. She manipulates Gülsüm's fears and benefits from her through charms, readings, and superstition.
Gülsüm's husband. He is suspected by Gülsüm and Nefise of writing the 'Pasaklı Gülsüm' text and planning to remarry.
Nefise Hanım's husband. Often appears in comic domestic scenes and is shown as passive in relation to Nefise.
Rıfkı's mother / Gülsüm's mother-in-law figure, described as disabled or bedridden and dependent in the household.
Gülsüm and Rıfkı's son; mentioned in relation to household food, school, and family conflict.
Gülsüm's mother. Appears in the household and later accompanies or supports Gülsüm in some events.
Neighbor from the İmameciler household. Appears in neighborhood quarrels and later joins Gülsüm's group in confronting Nefise.
Neighboring family involved in quarrels with Nefise and Gülsüm.
Nefise Hanım's cat; important in the comic pastırma episode.
Neighbor's cat, mentioned during the quarrel about cats and stolen food.
Later character connected to visits to Nefise's house.
Later character connected to visits to Nefise's house.
A different groom candidate confused with Rıfkı Efendi in the later misunderstanding scene.
Coffeehouse boy mentioned when Nefise asks Gülsüm to call Hacı Baba from the coffeehouse.
Nefise Hanım's daughter, mentioned as being sent to a mansion as a servant/besleme.
